A toy whistle gets stuck in Bhide’s throat, causing a whistle sound every time he tries to speak. After Dr. Hathi suggests surgery (which terrifies Bhide), various funny home remedies fail—including vacuum suction and doing a headstand (shirshasana).
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
